description: This file defines an abstract ViewHolder class for representing note items in a RecyclerView within an Android application. It includes methods for binding note properties such as status, category, favorite state, and searchable content, as well as handling selection and swipe interactions.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: An abstract RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass used to display note items in a list, with methods to bind note properties and handle user interaction.

methods.name: NoteViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with a view and a click listener, setting recyclability.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Bind common note properties such as selection state, note data, category visibility, color theme, and search query highlighting.

methods.name: bindStatus
methods.description: Bind the note's status icon based on DBStatus, setting its visibility and tint.

methods.name: bindCategory
methods.description: Bind the note's category text and style it based on theme and display options.

methods.name: bindFavorite
methods.description: Set the favorite icon and click listener for toggling favorite state.

methods.name: bindSearchableContent
methods.description: Set the note's content text and highlight search matches if present.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Abstract method to show swipe actions (left or right).

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the swipeable view for a note item.

methods.name: getItemDetails
methods.description: Provides item details for selection support, including position and key.
